# orionbelt_user (List Resource)

Find users on the gateway, sorted by username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform query -generate-config-out=users.tf
list "orionbelt_user" "operators" {
  provider = orionbelt

  config {
    role = "operator"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `role` (String) Only users with this role: admin, operator, auditor or user.
- `username_prefix` (String) Only users whose username starts with this.
